implementationStateAtFreeze: S05 runtime controller skeleton present; no fixture, calibration, confirmatory, or matching-sensitivity run executed
frozenQuestion: Does recovery triggered only by explicit local contact evidence produce repair outcomes distinguishable from spontaneous recovery schedules matched to each mechanism's calibration-split marginal recovery-time distribution, with censored cases retained and no confirmatory-outcome conditioning?

inherits.checkpointState: occupancy, Selection cursors, activation count/global event clock, native stream counters, native ledger, and an initially fresh S05 runtime overlay

runtimeOverlay.rootScenarioId: retain the original executable S01 scenario ID
runtimeOverlay.placement: after proposal construction and authoritative mechanical validation, before conflict resolution and commit
runtimeOverlay.freezeMobility: while active, selected identity cannot initiate an eligible state change or be the target of an eligible Swap
runtimeOverlay.policyVisibility: the selected cell remains normal in policy-visible observations, as in S04
runtimeOverlay.recoveryBoundary: the triggering contact remains blocked; recovery takes effect for the next charged opportunity
runtimeOverlay.claimBoundary: runtime mobility equivalence only; no static-stuck scenario reconstruction or changed RNG root

contactEvent.eligibility: an authoritative mechanically eligible Swap involving the selected frozen identity
contactEvent.locality: absolute pre-event actor-target position difference equals one
contactEvent.counting: at most one qualifying contact record per charged serial opportunity
contactEvent.otherIdentity: immutable identity ID of the non-selected Swap participant
contactEvent.side: left or right from the non-selected participant's pre-event position relative to the selected identity
contactEvent.inbound: the non-selected neighbor is the initiating actor and the selected identity is the trusted target

mechanisms.semantics: recover after the third qualifying adjacent contact, regardless of initiator and without reset or decay
add exactly one proxy unit for each qualifying inbound neighbor-initiated displacement attempt and recover at three units; units never decay
recover after qualifying contacts involving two distinct immutable non-selected identity IDs
recover when the rolling inclusive 16-opportunity window contains qualifying inbound contacts from both pre-event sides by two distinct immutable neighbor identities
mechanisms.quorum: one left identity and one different right identity
mechanisms.state: event-indexed deque of inbound identity and side evidence

matching.donorOutcome: calibration active-arm recovery duration in charged opportunities, or an explicit unrecovered/censored sentinel
matching.assignment: counter-addressed deterministic bijection between calibration donor records and confirmatory recipients within each declared stratum
matching.runtimeDraws: none; the assigned schedule is frozen before each control trajectory
matching.censoring: unrecovered calibration cases remain point-mass donor records and are never dropped or imputed
matching.outcomeConditioningProhibited: assignment strata, ranks, and schedules do not use confirmatory completion, distance, recovery, or terminal outcomes

pairingContract.preProcess: all arms share the exact S02 checkpoint, S03 reversal anchor occupancy/hash, selected identity, global clock, native stream counters, ledger, target, and phase budget
pairingContract.baseRuntimeRoot: same original executable scenario ID and seed
pairingContract.matchingStream: construction-only isolated stream with no dummy runtime draws
pairingContract.staticReconstructionContrast: not executed; a reconstructed stuck Scenario would be scenario_paired_rng_unpaired

validationPanel.sourceConstruction: exact reconstruction of all validated S02 checkpoints followed by the validated S03 central segment reversal anchor

successCriteria.primaryEstimand: within each mechanism, paired confirmatory completion difference between contact-dependent recovery and empirical_bijection_n_policy_v1 spontaneous recovery
successCriteria.test: two-sided exact McNemar test on discordant pairs
successCriteria.multiplicity: Holm correction across four mechanisms at family-wise alpha 0.05
successCriteria.supportive: all validation gates pass and at least one mechanism has Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05
successCriteria.null: all validation gates pass and no mechanism has Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05
successCriteria.constrainingContradictory: a required semantic, matching, replay, accounting, or inherited-contract validation fails, or the mechanism/control comparison is not identifiable
secondary: robustness across n-only and pooled empirical-bijection matching choices
successCriteria.censorRule: retain every non-recovery and terminal case in the primary completion table; do not form a recovered-only outcome cohort

claimBoundary: S05 tests transparent computational recovery rules. Contact, pressure, quorum, recovery, and repair are operational simulator constructs, not biological or mechanical measurements.
